Mirror the server fork: validate string size before the header, then pass that same unsigned count to ByteStream::put. This avoids the separate size_t narrowing diagnosed by native Debug x64 /WX.

Validation: existing client fixtures pass 50/50 Win32 and 57/57 Win64 under Wine; native v120 clientAudio rebuilds pass all four Debug/Release and Win32/x64 configurations with the companion Audio narrowing fix. Legacy 65534/65535 headers remain unchanged. ByteStream internals and nested partial-failure semantics remain outside this change.

Source-only extraction. The historical test/CI changes described below remain in the original commit and are excluded from this branch.

Check logical read/advance bounds and unsigned append arithmetic. Allocate and copy before publishing replacement storage; retain aliased source bytes through self-append and detach shared storage before reserve. Handle optional pool insertion failure without retaining its lock, and keep debug pointer sentinels at pointer width. Public client widths/layout and representable wire bytes remain unchanged. Bound empty-stream zero-byte reads consistently succeed.

Native v120 with real bundled STLport/core libraries:85/85 bounded checks in Debug/Release on both ABIs. Independent host review probes18/18 per ABI. Integration rerun:59/59 and66/66 wire checks plus85/85 portable buffer checks. Add the bounded buffer runner to existing fork CI. Matching server-fork algorithm passes85/85 and existing19/20 wire checks. No unsafe historical fault reproduction.

Limits: raw-pointer decoders still need their own preflight, invalidation after clear/refill is not tracked, nested delta state is not transactional, and allocation-failure guarantees have source review rather than injected-failure runtime evidence. Full-client networking remains unverified.
